message.content:
Here’s a classic lasagna recipe with all the essential ingredients you’ll need:

| Category | Ingredient | Typical Amount (for a 9 × 13 in. pan) |
|----------|------------|---------------------------------------|
| **Lasagna sheets** | Dry lasagna noodles (no‑boil or regular) | 12–15 sheets |
| **Meat sauce** | Ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | 1 ½ lb (680 g) |
| | Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 |
| | Crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce | 28 oz (800 g) |
| | Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp |
| | Olive oil | 1 Tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| | Italian seasoning (oregano, basil, thyme) | 1 tsp each |
| | Red pepper flakes (optional) | pinch |
| | Fresh basil or parsley (optional) | handful, chopped |
| | Parmesan cheese, grated (optional) | ¼ cup |
| **Ricotta mixture** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Egg (helps bind) | 1 large |
| | Grated Parmesan | ¼ cup |
| | Fresh parsley or basil, chopped | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| **Bechamel (white sauce)** | Butter | 4 Tbsp |
| | All‑purpose flour | 4 Tbsp |
| | Milk (whole or 2%) | 4 cups (1 L) |
| | Nutmeg (freshly grated) | pinch |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| **Cheese topping** | Shredded mozzarella | 2 cups (200 g) |
| | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup (50 g) |
| | Optional: shredded provolone or fontina | ½ cup |

### Optional Extras
- **Vegetables**: Sautéed spinach, zucchini, mushrooms, or bell peppers can be layered in for extra flavor and nutrition.
- **Herbs**: A splash of red wine or a few bay leaves in the meat sauce can deepen the taste.
- **Spices**: A dash of smoked paprika or a pinch of cayenne for a subtle kick.

With these ingredients, you’ll have everything you need to assemble a hearty, comforting lasagna. Happy cooking!
